كُتَّابٌ , see مَكْتَبٌ ＝
-A2- The same, (S, K,) as also كُثَّابٌ, q. v., but the former is the more approved: (S: the reverse, however, is said in the TA; and MF says that some authors altogether reject كتّاب, with ت, in the sense here following:) A kind of small, round-headed, arrow, with which boys learn to shoot. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
